// dir: x
// want: analyzer "file-size" declares "max_lines", nothing reads it
// want: x get: key is not a constant
// with: core
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/core"

type holder[T any] struct{ params core.ParamSet }

func (holder holder[T]) get(key string) int { return holder.params.Int(key, 1) }
